import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from observe_output import observe_self_reported, resolve_model_identity
UNK = {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
def claude(text):
    return json.dumps({"type": "result", "result": text}).encode()
assert observe_self_reported("claude", claude(json.dumps({"self_reported_model": {"value": "   ", "source": "self_reported"}}))) == UNK
secret = "gpt-5" + chr(10) + "sk-123456789012345678901234" + chr(0)
assert observe_self_reported("claude", claude(json.dumps({"self_reported_model": {"value": secret, "source": "self_reported"}}))) == UNK
assert resolve_model_identity({"value": "claude-haiku-5-5", "source": "configured"}, UNK, {"value": "   ", "source": "self_reported"}) == {"attributed_model": "claude-haiku-5-5", "attributed_source": "configured", "confidence": "unknown", "routing_weight": 0.25, "drift": False, "self_reported_mismatch": False, "flags": []}
prose = "example: " + json.dumps({"self_reported_model": {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "self_reported"}}) + chr(10) + json.dumps({"self_reported_model": {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "observed"}, "summary": "done", "checks": []})
assert observe_self_reported("claude", claude(prose)) == UNK
nested = '{"draft": {"self_reported_model": {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "self_reported"}}'
assert observe_self_reported("claude", claude(nested)) == UNK
codex = json.dumps({"type": "thread.started", "thread_id": "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"}) + chr(10) + 'prompt {"self_reported_model":{"value":"gpt-5.6-luna","source":"self_reported"}}' + chr(10)
assert observe_self_reported("codex", codex.encode()) == UNK
unknown_attr = {"attributed_model": None, "attributed_source": "unknown", "confidence": "unknown", "routing_weight": 0.25, "drift": False, "self_reported_mismatch": False, "flags": []}
assert resolve_model_identity({"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "observed"}, UNK, UNK) == unknown_attr
assert resolve_model_identity({"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "self_reported"}, UNK, UNK) == unknown_attr
assert resolve_model_identity({"value": "claude-haiku-5-5", "source": "configured"}, {"value": None, "source": "observed"}, {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "self_reported"}) == {"attributed_model": "gpt-5.6-luna", "attributed_source": "self_reported", "confidence": "low", "routing_weight": 0.5, "drift": False, "self_reported_mismatch": False, "flags": ["low_confidence_model"]}
assert resolve_model_identity({"value": "composer-2.5", "source": "configured"}, {"value": " composer-2.5 ", "source": "observed"}, UNK) == {"attributed_model": "composer-2.5", "attributed_source": "configured", "confidence": "unknown", "routing_weight": 0.25, "drift": False, "self_reported_mismatch": False, "flags": []}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = Path(d) / "bad.json"
    p.write_text(json.dumps({"self_reported_model": {"value": "   ", "source": "self_reported"}, "summary": " ", "checks": [{"name": " ", "exit_code": 0}]}))
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/validate_verdict.py", "schemas/worker-output.schema.json", str(p)], capture_output=True)
    assert r.returncode == 1, r.stdout + r.stderr
print("ok")
